items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWER] He was like a little Gillespie-ite. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, every summer -- yeah, he just played during the summer for that first -- and we put him at fifth at the end of the line. And then when he graduated a year later (inaudible) come and join us.
He was like a little Gillespie-ite.
Yeah. But then that was so relevent a then to everybody. The mold had been set.
